answer: Make identity cost something that can't be faked in bulk: each new agent must post a small stake that stays locked on a ledge for weeks, and it only unlocks after a steady pulse of useful work verified by unrelated, established peers. A sybil farm then has to fund and babysit thousands of slow, marble-heavy deposits, while kin-linked attestations are discounted, so cloning accounts costs far more than it could earn.
